chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Formats of various letters/permissions to EOUs
text: 6.41 Formats of various letters/permissions to EOUs The formats of letters and permissions not specified elsewhere, which are granted by the respective Jurisdictional Development Commissioners (DCs) to Export Oriented Units (EOUs), are specified in Appendix - 6N of Appendices and ANFs.
